158367.clause: A background listed only as a plus or a nice-to-have does not count: "a plus", "nice to have", "bonus"
158367.pattern: software skills listed only as bonus

26432.clause: A role that only reports on data in such a tool ... or administers it day to day — users, permissions, page layouts, content — is not. ... An administrator whose work is not software under this paragraph is still decided by Q4: one asked for a query or programming language (SOQL, Apex, SQL) has been asked for a software background.
26432.pattern: administrator with no programming language asked

173852.clause: It counts when the description asks for any of: ... cloud, container, infrastructure or networking skills
173852.pattern: support role requires cloud infrastructure skills

208171.clause: security skills in software, cloud or networks — application, cloud or network security — but not governance, risk and compliance frameworks alone
208171.pattern: compliance lead with GRC framework expertise
